direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just asked Kasun whether the small food business is his. They stand beside his three-wheeler.
direction.people: Anudi stands on the left in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt, curious and at ease. Her phone is in her right hand at her waist, her open umbrella in her left hand and her handbag on her left forearm. Kasun faces her from the right in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, friendly and unselfconscious, with empty hands at his sides.

flow.text: They remain turned toward each other. Kasun meets her expectant gaze.

flow.how: Friendly and modest, confirming ownership without apology, with a slight nod
flow.listener: Anudi keeps her eyes on him and raises her eyebrows slightly.

flow.how: After a brief beat, warmly curious about whether he manages alone, tilting her head a fraction toward him
flow.listener: Kasun watches her, then draws a quiet breath.

flow.text: Anudi waits with a small smile. They stay facing each other.

direction.camera: Eye-level waist-up two-shot from the road side on a 40mm lens, steady frame on a tripod, with the three-wheeler behind Kasun.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
